import "context"

type Key string

func (key *Key) UnmarshalText(text []byte) error {
	*key = Key("changed-" + string(text))
	return nil
}

type Input map[Key]string

type Output struct {
	Value string `json:"value"`
}

func Invoke(context.Context, Input) (ToolResponse[Output], error) {
	return ToolResponse[Output]{Accepted: true}, nil
}
